opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases, by prior agreement; most grants below £300,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not open to individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any organisation, schools or further education colleges, undergraduates or master's students, or projects where the main purpose is to support a PhD. In exceptional cases overseas organisations may apply if no UK-based host is feasible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year in Autumn.
